Fuess and Stearns, comps.  The Little Book of Society Verse.  1922.

By. Thomas Moore

To Phyllis

P
HYLLIS,
 you little rosy rake,
That heart of yours I long to rifle:
Come, give it me, and do not make
So much ado about a 
trifle!
